stages.title: Inventory and reproducible qualification setup

Select one primary host/project and define a lab-side fallback topology; record deliberately unavailable hardware as an inventory gap rather than inventing a board/probe.

Qualification run template populated with versions/topology
exitCriteria: ADB can install/run a minimal development build on the target, or an exact blocker is documented.
No host OS, decoder, peripheral, or compositor support is inferred from model name.

stages.title: Platform API, lifecycle, and capability probes
tasks: Inspect the API tracker and pin candidate SDK/AndroidX versions for windows, caption bounds, input, files, direct LAN permission, and foreground-service experiments.
Build minimal resize/multi-instance/caption/focus probes with runtime guards and record experimental annotations.
Classify SSH, transfers, USB, and streaming lifecycle strategies independently; force relevant timeout/process-recreation cases.
Investigate supported local Linux VM attach/control interfaces; record absence or roadmap status without private-API assumptions.
Record CAP-PLATFORM as supported, bounded experiment or blocked, with scope and evidence; investigation completion does not activate dependent implementation.
deliverables: API availability/compile-probe table
Operation-specific lifecycle decision note and VM boundary record
CAP-PLATFORM outcome and any bounded follow-up experiment
exitCriteria: Every proposed API use has a version guard or fallback.
System IME/launcher and Linux roadmap limits are reflected in release scope.

stages.title: SSH engine and terminal renderer qualification
tasks: Compare maintained JVM/native SSH candidates for Android ABI, algorithms/trust, PTY/SFTP/jumps/forwards, X11 channel/cookie hooks, footprint, license and update ownership; probe SSH authentication and SFTP operations independently of any terminal renderer.
Embed a pinned local xterm.js experiment with a narrow native boundary and compare a native renderer if needed.

Run exact-byte paste, CJK IME/preedit, wide-cell/emoji, TUI, selection, resize and sustained-output cases with physical desktop inputs. Apply the desktop interaction contract; mobile component defaults cannot satisfy desktop acceptance.
Record CPU/memory/input latency and accessible terminal behavior; select the engine/renderer or a bounded remediation experiment.

Record separate CAP-SSH and CAP-TERMINAL feasibility verdicts with scope and evidence. Final supported readiness also requires the relevant P1-S4 adoption decision; renderer-only IME/accessibility failure must not block a qualified SSH/SFTP route or be hidden by its success.
deliverables: Renderer/SSH ADR with versions and rejected alternatives
Input/TUI fixture results and local-renderer boundary probe
Separate CAP-SSH and CAP-TERMINAL outcomes with any bounded follow-up experiments
exitCriteria: First-trust/changed-key, SSH/SFTP and terminal-input probes have separate actual-hardware verdicts; an unsuccessful route is blocked or a bounded experiment and cannot inherit another route's pass.
Unresolved accessibility/IME failures block terminal renderer adoption, not a separately supported SSH/SFTP approach or completion of the investigation record.

stages.title: USB provider and real programming workflow
tasks: Complete the reviewed USB provider entry: separate public Android grant/FD access from actual network export and host import. Build a real libusb-backed diagnostic without claiming or resetting a peripheral, while retaining VirtualHere as an external candidate and full integrated plug-and-play scope. See docs/03-platform/googlebook/p0-s5-usb-provider-entry.md.
Verify Android provider/workstation consumer licensing, permission ownership and consumer-side API on the actual USB topology.
Program/verify the actual board/probe with runtime/bootloader/DFU/composite identities recorded.
Probe hotplug, replug, permission denial, auto-use toggle/state semantics, consumer restart, contention and protected ownership reconciliation in a controlled lab.

Record CAP-USB feasibility verdict with scope and evidence; its final supported readiness also requires the relevant P1-S4 engine/distribution decision, and investigation completion alone does not activate implementation.

User decision 2026-10-15: no board/probe selected; preserve full generic USB scope. Complete official API/provider/licensing and software-state investigation while physical attach/reset/programming evidence remains unavailable; no universal support or synthetic gate pass.

Backend control/auto-use decision and tested fallback topology
CAP-USB outcome and any bounded follow-up experiment
exitCriteria: The actual target's program/verify attempt has evidence and a scoped verdict; serial-only success never certifies JTAG/DFU, and failure leaves that capability blocked.
Ownership recovery is demonstrated without automatic flash retry or timer-based reassignment, or its exact blocker and bounded next experiment are recorded.

stages.title: X11 forwarding and native application-window feasibility
tasks: Prove ordinary SSH x11-req/cookie substitution with remote xauth and two isolated host contexts.
Build a maintained Android X server candidate and prototype top-level, transient-dialog and popup mapping to Googlebook native windows without root/private APIs.
Test physical keyboard/IME, focus, caption/resize/display scaling, clipboard boundaries and disconnect/process-death semantics.

Record CAP-X11 feasibility verdict with scope and evidence; its final supported readiness also requires the relevant P1-S4 engine/distribution decision, and investigation completion alone does not activate implementation.

Per-application window support/failure matrix and re-estimate
CAP-X11 outcome and any bounded follow-up experiment
exitCriteria: Two remote apps have independent native desktop windows and correct owned dialogs, or the required capability is explicitly blocked with a scope proposal.
Cookie/trust isolation and actual GUI lifetime have recorded verdicts; a supported route cannot rely on root/shared-signing/private VM behavior, and failed cases remain blocked.

stages.title: Network measurements and scoped system decisions
tasks: Measure direct/relay routing for available stream/RDP/VNC/files and reverse USB branches; add X11 evidence from P0-S7 when available without blocking unrelated lanes.
Record independent payload/wire counters plus repeatable Moonlight/Parsec comparisons where supported; label GeForce NOW contextual.
Run controlled latency/jitter/loss/route/outage profiles outside protected programming and measure adaptation/recovery/input integrity.
Ratify or revise per-lane desktop budgets and estimates; record explicit blockers, tested fallbacks and support exclusions for each branch.
Reconcile capability outcomes and stage readiness; publish scoped go/experiment/blocked decisions and re-estimate after evidence without treating completed research as feature support.
deliverables: Primary topology latency/pacing/traffic/recovery baseline with raw evidence
Scoped go/experiment/blocked decisions; X11 investigation remains separately required for full Console
exitCriteria: Each measured lane has evidence, limits and a capability decision; pending X11 work is named and cannot be counted as a passing result.
Neither app waits for an unrelated capability decision; its own required gates remain mandatory.

stages.title: Native app targets and shared-module build foundation
tasks: Establish two independently installable signed development APK targets, shared source boundaries and reproducible Android/NDK toolchains selected from P0.
Apply Rule 0: desktop/laptop Googlebook target, separate package IDs/app data, no phone/tablet UI workstream; document manifest/ABI/minSdk/targetSdk and channel assumptions.
Build native shells with per-window context and real lifecycle state; keep baseline SSH/RDP/VNC independent of the custom host agent.
Document APK installation versus AAB publishing and verify package install/update/uninstall using authorized Android tooling.
deliverables: Two installable debug APKs and toolchain lock record
Module graph and minimal launch smoke evidence
exitCriteria: Each app launches with the other app absent.
No source module depends on the other app process or UI.

stages.title: Cloudy design system and native shell
tasks: Implement canonical Cloudy tokens and native desktop controls with user font scaling, two themes, density and system caption bounds.
Prototype resizable terminal+SFTP arrangements, X11 app/dialog windows, backend profile/trust screens, USB enrollment and diagnostics.

Qualify keyboard navigation, shortcut discovery, right-click/hover/cursors, range selection, pointer/touch access and focus ownership on Googlebook. Preserve ordinary native field editing and explicit per-surface shortcut ownership under D14.
Run narrow tiled/short windows, multi-instance and display-scale changes; preserve desktop workflows without adding phone/tablet navigation.
Run the native workspace review with two host contexts, terminal/SFTP, X11 modal, RDP/VNC input release and a device interruption; label synthetic and engine-backed evidence separately.
Record Q-A02 shell/geometry findings and feature-specific pending checks before freezing revised interaction components.

Rule 0 and applicable official desktop-quality evidence ledger
Native workspace review record with accepted geometry/focus decisions and explicit provisional components
exitCriteria: No system control overlap, focus trap, unreadable semantic pair, or unreachable scaled action.
Visual choices preserve terminal/file/media working area and clear host context.
Freeze only demonstrated native component geometry/interaction; unresolved engine-dependent behavior remains provisional and linked to its feature stage.

stages.title: Identity, typed contracts, and lifecycle persistence
tasks: Implement per-app protected credential handles, known-host trust storage, enrollment cancellation, and revocation. Implement signature-protected explicit IPC with bounded versioned resource envelopes, caller validation, expiration, and receiver-side resource resolution.

Define X11 broker/SSH/window lifetimes, URI staging grants, per-backend client ownership and USB enrollment restoration without a shared immortal daemon.

Threat-boundary and denial/revocation evidence
exitCriteria: No exported secret/raw command through handoff, logs, or renderer messages.
Process recreation restores metadata without replaying a side effect.

stages.title: Early native-stream adoption and distribution decision
tasks: Review the P0 native-engine feasibility probe and exact upstream/dependency obligations during the foundation phase, before committing the streaming implementation.

Apply D16/ADR0010: open-source Desktop with compatible terms and required source/notices/build materials. Finalize exact license expression, actual dependency closure/SBOM, corresponding source and maintenance/reproducible build route; direction is selected, complete release obligations are not yet satisfied.
Record native surface/input/decoder and backend-version boundaries; estimate remaining integration from the actual probe.
Record CAP-STREAM as supported, bounded experiment or blocked. A blocker does not prevent ordinary SSH, RDP or VNC work; an external-only alternative needs an explicit user-visible scope decision.
Keep the early external stream lane available while native integration proceeds on its own prerequisites, independently of optional host adapters and event integrations.

Pinned maintenance/build plan, CAP-STREAM outcome and revised estimate
exitCriteria: The adoption investigation has a recorded outcome; only a supported CAP-STREAM outcome can activate native stream implementation.
No implementation or distribution right is inferred from an external app, and no native-stream scope reduction is made without an explicit decision.

stages.title: CI, dependency decision, and foundation gate
tasks: Add real Android build/lint/unit/instrumentation checks and contract fixture validation; retain documentation checks.

Record exact dependency versions/licenses/update owners, actual artifact SBOM and compatible distribution terms. D16/ADR0010 selects open-source Desktop; retain independent Console terms and no blanket repository license inference. Finalize required corresponding source/notices/build materials before release.
Exercise mismatched app/protocol versions, missing recipient, unavailable permissions, and independent install/uninstall.
Publish the P1 evidence bundle and refine remaining stage estimates using actual implementation results.
Resolve X server, FreeRDP, VNC engine and transitive native codec/license/security/build obligations before P2/P3 embedding; P5 stream review does not substitute for this gate.

Finalize each engine capability outcome after its own feasibility and distribution/build review, including separate CAP-SSH transport and CAP-TERMINAL renderer adoption. A blocked renderer, X11, VNC or USB choice leaves that feature blocked without holding the independently usable foundation or unrelated app lanes.
deliverables: Reproducible CI artifacts and dependency register
Foundation gate record with unresolved issues
exitCriteria: Both apps install independently and communicate only through validated resource contracts.
CI output is labeled separately from physical-device evidence.
Every reviewed engine has an explicit scoped readiness outcome; unresolved feature-specific adoption is not hidden by the foundation being done.

stages.title: Shared SSH transport, authentication, and jumps
tasks: Implement reusable SSH profile/engine adapters for connect/cancel, host trust, authentication and typed failures; each consuming app supplies its own profile store, credentials, jobs and lifecycle.
Add key/password/keyboard-interactive methods supported by the selected engine through a typed native authentication-prompt contract; do not require a PTY, terminal renderer or Console process.
Implement jump chains with trust at every hop and clean channel shutdown.
Exercise key change, wrong credentials, offline DNS/route, authentication cancel and per-host revocation in an isolated native test consumer, then repeat applicable cases in each consuming app.
deliverables: Reusable SSH transport/authentication/jump library and native prompt contract
Profile/trust/authentication fixtures and evidence independent of Console UI
exitCriteria: A plain SSH server works through the shared library with no PTY, terminal renderer, other app process or custom host agent; source reuse never shares credential stores.
Changed keys block before secrets are sent and errors identify the failing layer.

stages.title: Shared SFTP transfer, staging, and publication core
tasks: Implement shared SFTP browsing/action primitives, capability discovery and URI-grant-aware upload/download/directory jobs on the qualified SSH transport; no terminal, pane, tab or installed Console dependency.
Build bounded local staging, source-version-bound resume, integrity checks, transfer journals and typed publication/recovery states with per-app storage, credentials, grants and job ownership.

Implement exclusive-copy and conditional/ordinary publication semantics. Every non-conditional overwrite requires explicit consent bound to the exact file/destination/save generation; expose a typed decision request that each app presents in native UI, with save-copy/cancel and no remembered blanket consent.

Define staging content-provider grants and late/seekable receiver behavior without requiring the later remote DocumentsProvider. Preserve local work and reconcile lost acknowledgements/process death without replaying destructive operations.

Exercise actual SSH/SFTP servers through a native qualification consumer with the terminal renderer absent: source changes, denied/revoked URI access, directory partial failure, name collisions, another writer between check/publish and ambiguous completion.
Publish the reusable source contract and evidence; Console attachments/pane and Desktop cross-root UI must repeat their integration-specific cases using the same core with independent app state.
deliverables: Shared SSH/SFTP transfer library, journal/staging content-provider contract and typed publication decision interface
Native consumer evidence for integrity, per-save consent, concurrent writes and recovery without Console UI
exitCriteria: Browse/upload/download/stage-edit and cancellation/recovery pass against the qualified ordinary SSH/SFTP server with no terminal renderer, Console panes or custom host agent.
Every non-conditional overwrite is bound to its explicit save decision; canceled or obsolete decisions preserve staging and cannot publish a newer revision.
Exclusive-copy collisions never truncate an existing file, and ambiguous completion never triggers blind rename/overwrite replay or a false remote-commit claim.
The core owns no global credentials or permanently shared process; consuming apps independently own their stores, URI grants, lifecycle and transfer jobs.

stages.title: Interactive terminal correctness and bounded data path
tasks: Connect PTY bytes/resize to the selected renderer with bounded queues/backpressure off the UI thread.

Implement negotiated terminal features, exact paste/composition, selection, clipboard policy, and external link opening. Exercise editors, agent menus/diffs, alternate screen, mouse reporting, Unicode widths, and long prompts.
Measure local input/render latency, sustained output, scrollback bounds, and accessible terminal behavior.
deliverables: Working PTY surface and supported-feature declaration
Exact-byte and sustained-load evidence
exitCriteria: No duplicate/lost paste or committed IME text and no stuck modifiers.
Supported output rate is sustained without silent loss or unbounded growth.

stages.title: Tabs, panes, windows, search, and durable sessions

Recover from network loss/process eviction/host reboot with actual session identity and no input/command replay.

Durability/resize/restore compatibility matrix

A saved layout that no longer fits keeps sessions reachable without terminating them.

stages.title: SFTP attachments and local browser forwards

Hash/path/permission and preview evidence

Forwarded content never loads inside the privileged renderer.

stages.title: SSH X11 forwarding and separate native app windows

Map top-level windows, transient/modal dialogs, popups, close requests and host labels to native Googlebook windows with accurate input/IME/scale.
Add per-session graphical-window list, restricted/trusted mode policy, prerequisites and layer-specific diagnostics.
Exercise multiple hosts/apps, reconnect, timeout, activity/process recreation and GUI termination without command replay or false tmux durability.

X11 window/input/trust/lifecycle qualification matrix
exitCriteria: Required separate remote app windows and owned dialogs pass on Googlebook without Desktop or custom host agent.

stages.title: Session-linked SFTP pane and bidirectional drag-and-drop

Incoming/outgoing drop and remote-edit integrity evidence
exitCriteria: Browse/upload/download/edit and both Android drop directions pass with Desktop absent, correct captured host/path, and no auto-submit.

Every non-conditional remote overwrite has consent for that file and save generation; known conflicts and ambiguous completion preserve staged work and do not trigger an automatic overwrite retry.

stages.title: Agent workflows, profile import and independent Console release gate

Daily-use report and release limitations
Independent Console candidate/support decision with app-scoped release evidence

stages.title: Native integrated RDP client

Record optional RemoteApp/gateway/redirection support separately; test with Console and the custom host agent absent.
deliverables: Integrated RDP profile/connect/session workflow
Pinned engine/server/security/input/recovery and performance matrix
exitCriteria: A native RDP session passes identity/auth/input/render/recovery cases on the primary supported server; external launch alone is insufficient.
No silent security downgrade, protocol switch, duplicated input or unsupported session/RemoteApp claim.

Actual relative 3D/capture/release and protected saved-credential cases pass for each claimed combination; unsupported host/auth/input modes remain explicit. No mobile-only gesture requirement or diagnostic plaintext vault substitute.

stages.title: Native integrated VNC client
tasks: Embed the license/security-approved RFB client behind the native desktop interface and add explicit encoding/security/server profiles.

Qualify primary VNC servers, malformed/unsupported updates, network recovery and file handoff through independent SFTP where available.
deliverables: Integrated VNC profile/connect/session workflow
RFB engine/server/encoding/security and latency/recovery matrix
exitCriteria: Native VNC desktop/input/recovery works with Console/custom host agent absent on the supported server matrix; external viewer launch alone is insufficient.
No plaintext/None security downgrade, state-corrupting update drops, or assumed universal file-transfer extension.

stages.title: Independent Desktop companion release gate
tasks: Run native RDP and VNC, qualified external stream handoff, files and enrolled USB with Console and the optional Cloudy host agent absent; record any separately required USB consumer adapter.
Complete the primary edit/build/program/inspect workflow through the remote desktop and Desktop file/device tools, preserving host/project/device context.
Interrupt and restore connectivity without replaying commands or losing ownership accounting; export measured usage and the supported backend/device matrix.
Run the app-scoped release checklist for signed Desktop install/update/recovery, dependency/notices, setup/support documentation and at least ten working days of candidate use.
Publish the independent R2 candidate decision; Console/X11, optional host events and later native streaming do not block a qualified R2 scope.
deliverables: Independent Desktop functional/quality report and R2 candidate decision
App-scoped support table, setup/recovery material and dependency installation list
exitCriteria: R2 includes native RDP/VNC, files, enrolled USB plug-and-play and honest external performance-stream handoff on qualified combinations, with its own release checklist passed.
Desktop functions with Console absent and no borrowed credentials/process; a Console-specific X11 blocker cannot hold this gate.

stages.title: Console/Desktop suite integration milestone
tasks: Connect/build in Console, upload the artifact, hand off the registered workspace to Desktop and perform visual work.
Program/verify the target and inspect output while preserving host/project/device identity and each app's independent credentials.
Exercise missing counterpart, version skew and interruption; reconcile transfers/ownership without replaying commands.
Record the combined suite result separately from the already independently releasable app candidates.
deliverables: Complete cross-app build/program/inspect report
Suite handoff/version-skew and context-integrity evidence
exitCriteria: Both app candidates pass their own gates and the combined journey passes without sharing credentials or requiring a shared daemon.
A suite-only failure blocks promotion of that suite integration; it does not revoke an unaffected standalone support claim.

stages.title: Host agent pairing, capabilities, jobs, and resumable events
tasks: Implement separately versioned host core with authenticated pairing, revocation, scopes, and capability negotiation.
Add request IDs/expiration/idempotency policy, registered roots, managed jobs, and bounded diagnostics.
Implement stream/boot identities, sequence/cursors, retention, gap snapshots, and event persistence.
Test unauthorized/stale requests, repeated IDs, disconnects, restart, missing backend, and version skew.
deliverables: Optional host-core service and protocol implementation
Pairing/replay/gap/expiry fixtures
exitCriteria: Ordinary Console SSH still works without the agent.
A repeated request or event cannot silently repeat a side effect.

stages.title: Windows user-session notification adapter
tasks: Validate packaging/capability and user-consent requirements for UserNotificationListener.
Implement source/text/icon/dismissal capabilities that are actually supported, with bounded icon handling.
Handle access denial/revocation, session switching, host restart, and background synchronization explicitly.
Test Android permission/channel denial and keep the in-app activity path functional.

Permission/fidelity capability matrix
exitCriteria: Correct host/source attribution and no stale-action promises.
Revoked access is distinct from an empty healthy inbox.

stages.title: Linux and macOS scoped event adapters
tasks: Evaluate supported Linux desktop notification integration against the actual daemon/compositor.
Implement macOS own-job/app-specific events and permission-aware status; keep arbitrary notification capture uncommitted.
Separate user-session helper lifecycle from the background host core.
Qualify source attribution, capability absence, permission changes, lock/logout/restart, and adapter errors.

Physical-session event runs
exitCriteria: No universal notification observer claim without a supported interface.
Own-job events remain useful when system-wide forwarding is unavailable.

stages.title: Agent hooks, event deduplication, and R3 gate
tasks: Add version-pinned supported hooks for selected managed jobs/agent tools; keep generic PTY operation independent.
Bind running/waiting/completed/failed states to current job/request/session identities.
Deduplicate events across both apps, suppress loops, respect expiry, and avoid offline reconnect alert storms.
Run event retention/offline/gap/permission scenarios and publish exact per-OS fidelity.
deliverables: R3 integrated activity release candidate
Hook/version/fidelity and offline replay report
exitCriteria: No screen-text inference or replayed approval operation.
Expired history remains history rather than newly actionable notifications.

stages.title: Native high-performance stream and latency/stability qualification
tasks: Integrate the approved maintained native stream engine with direct media/input, native Surface and measured decoder/profile selection.
Minimize copies/queue age, use supported low-latency decoder modes, and implement backend-supported adaptation with stable audio/video pacing.

Matched comparison/pacing/power/stability results with explicit target decisions
exitCriteria: Native media/input path and required real CAD work pass; no video through general UI bridges.
P0-ratified latency/quality/stability budgets have measured outcomes and no unresolved input/trust/data-integrity blocker; any scope change is explicit.

stages.title: DocumentsProvider and cached editing

Document backend semantic limits and cleanup/pinning/eviction settings.

Implement the selected file-publication policy: on a backend without conditional replacement, ask before every remote overwrite; offer save-copy/cancel, never remember blanket consent, and preserve pending staging.
Inject another writer between the last version check and publication, plus exclusive-name collision and lost-acknowledgement cases; never claim stat-plus-rename prevents concurrent lost updates.
deliverables: Qualified remote document provider
Consumer/cache/conflict/writeback matrix
exitCriteria: No remote file is labeled committed until the backend confirms publication.
Concurrent/offline edits preserve data and explicit conflict choices.
Every non-conditional remote overwrite has consent for that file and save generation; known conflicts and ambiguous completion preserve staged work and do not trigger an automatic overwrite retry.

stages.title: Metered policy, accounting, and integrated desktop gate
tasks: Add policy for hidden streams, thumbnails, prefetch, bitrate selection, and explicit large-transfer choices.
Label counters by interval/endpoint/direction/payload-or-wire/estimate and path-observability limits.
Compare app/stream counters with OS/router measurements without double-counting endpoint copies.
Run protected USB operations while changing bulk-transfer priorities and budget thresholds.
Measure file/USB contention and adaptive stream behavior with hysteresis; preserve protocol state and protected operations while prioritizing interactive work.
deliverables: R4 integrated desktop candidate and measured usage report
Metered policy/failure behavior evidence
exitCriteria: Counter scope is understandable and measured values align within declared boundaries.
Budget policy never silently interrupts protected programming or fabricates path telemetry.

stages.title: Failure injection, long sessions, and power transitions

Verify independent app operation, no command/approval/flash replay, and authoritative USB/file reconciliation.
Fix critical defects and narrow support claims where reliable behavior is not established.
Repeat required X11 window, SFTP grant/export/edit, RDP/VNC session and USB enrolled hotplug failure cases across suspend/resume and actual Googlebook process eviction.
Reuse app-scoped release evidence only for unchanged versions and applicable cases; run full-suite regressions without retroactively coupling standalone releases.
deliverables: Failure matrix and sustained-run evidence
Resolved critical defect list
exitCriteria: No silent data loss, unbounded growth, stuck input, or surprise side-effect replay in supported cases.
Failures produce actionable bounded diagnostics.

stages.title: Protocol skew, data migrations, updates, and rollback
tasks: Test old/new app pairs, agent/backend skew, unknown optional capabilities, and incompatible major versions.

Record release manifest, schema/dependency hashes, SBOM, and provenance of artifacts.

exitCriteria: An upgrade failure preserves recoverable user state and explains required action.
Rollback is limited to verified supported paths, not an assumed Android downgrade.

Write setup, trust/key recovery, backend installation, permissions, input release, file conflicts, USB recovery, and diagnostics guides.
Publish only measured OS/compositor/probe/codec combinations and list explicit deferred capabilities.
Publish the desktop-only applicability ledger; keep phone/tablet optimization and phone continuity outside required release work.

Distribution checklist tied to actual candidate
exitCriteria: Users can complete the primary journeys and recover from known failures with the shipped documentation.
Phone continuity outside scope and VM roadmap features do not become accidental release blockers/promises.

stages.title: Ten-working-day dogfood and release decision
tasks: Use the candidate for at least ten working days across real Console, visual, files, and hardware workflows.
Track defects by severity, recurrence, topology/version, data impact, and recovery cost; reserve effort for fixes.
Re-run only affected gates after changes and recheck critical complete journeys before promotion.
Approve release with evidence/support matrix or retain candidate status with explicit unresolved defects.
Dogfood the complete revised desktop ecosystem workflows, collect applicable official desktop-quality evidence, and label every unsupported backend/device capability.

R5 release decision and known limitations
